Players Committee card image of [[Darth Maul, Lone Hunter (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “If drawn for destiny, may take into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Cancels Blaster Deflection (and Amidala's game text) here. Maul's weapon destiny draws may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Immune to attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/darthmaullonehunter_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
